verdict.rationale: Bulk work is implied rather than documented. The Poly agent can handle multi-step reading, searching, writing and organizing in one request, and can automate tasks like organizing a folder. The CLI is scriptable, so it could loop over many files, and agents can spawn subagents to split up work. However, no evidence describes a dedicated bulk or batch operation (for example, multi-select move, retag or delete). missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operation docs, documented batch CLI or MCP commands, limits or scale guidance, hands-on corroboration of bulk edits across many files.
